messages.text: Hi.
I'm your personal health assistant.
To create the perfect plan for you, I need to know.
Your age, weekly time commitment,
30 minutes a few times or more,
workout preference, gym, home, or community,
Main goal, weight loss, strength, endurance, or general health?
And what motivates you, friends, solo, classes, or outdoors?
The more details, the better your personalized plan.
I'm 16. I can commit 30 minutes a week. My preference is
home. I my mango is strength, and I, uh, what motivates me is
being alone.
Thanks for that information about being 16.
Preferring home workouts, focusing on on strength,
and liking to exercise alone,
30 minutes a week is a good start.
Can you clarify what you mean by my mango is strength?
No. My main goal is strength.
Thanks for clarifying your main goal is strength.
Now about that 30 minutes a week,
is that 3 sessions of 10 minutes or 1 session of 30 minutes?
Uh, 3 session of 10 minutes. Sure.
I got it.
So 3 sessions of 10 minutes, 3 times a week.
At home,
and working on strength.
Perfect.
I have everything I need to create a personalized fitness plan
